lines.en: I walk with stiff, deliberate steps.
My armor plates knock together.

lines.zh: 我穿过沙地，留下一串深印。
lines.en: I cross the sand leaving deep prints.

lines.zh: 我拖着一只脚，声音很闷。
lines.en: I drag one foot with a dull sound.

lines.zh: 我的头裹在布里，看不出来。
lines.en: My head is wrapped in cloth, unreadable.

lines.zh: 我每一步都在缩短距离。
lines.en: Every step of mine eats the distance.
My joints barely bend.
I go around the pile of stones.
My stride settles as I go.

lines.zh: 沙子从我甲缝里漏下去。
lines.en: Sand trickles out of my armor seams.

lines.zh: 我慢慢地偏了方向，又转回来。
lines.en: I drift off line, then correct.
When I walk, my shoulders lead.

lines.zh: 我像根埋了半截的柱子。
lines.en: I stand like a half-buried post.

lines.zh: 我身上的旧布已经没有颜色。
lines.en: The old cloth on me has lost its color.
I keep to the shade.

lines.zh: 垂下的一条臂，像灌了沙。
lines.en: One hanging arm, heavy as if filled with sand.
I turn my face slowly.
I hear something very far away.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸声是布料的摩擦。
lines.en: My breath is the rustle of cloth.

lines.zh: 我站了很久，沙都盖到脚面。
lines.en: I've stood so long the sand covers my feet.
I move better once the sun is down.

lines.zh: 我的手指微微动了一下。
lines.en: My fingers move a little.

lines.zh: 你正好站在我要走的地方。
lines.en: You're standing right where I mean to walk.
You look softer than I expected.

lines.zh: 我在这片沙里走了很久。
lines.en: I've walked this sand a long while.

lines.zh: 你喘得太快，布都跟着颤。
lines.en: You breathe too fast; even my cloth stirs.

lines.zh: 活人身上的热气，我隔着布都感觉得到。
lines.en: I feel the warmth of the living even through my wrappings.
The iron on you is bright.

lines.zh: 我把脸从布缝里转过来。
lines.en: I turn my face out through the gap in my wraps.

lines.zh: 你不会以为我站不住吧。
lines.en: You don't think I can stand, do you?
The bandages on my hands are old.
Are you waiting for me to speak?

lines.zh: 这一击只让我晃了晃肩。
lines.en: That blow only rocked my shoulder.

lines.zh: 我的甲上多了一道缺口。
lines.en: A chip has appeared in my armor.
I forgot this kind of pain long ago.
I give half a step and slowly stop.
A wrap of my bandage has come loose.
Sand falls into the wound.
My head is slightly crooked.
I straighten it slowly.
I will still come on, step by step.
There has been no blood in me for ages.
Eating puts no flesh back on me.
You hold it up; I'm not interested.
My stomach left long ago.
That is yours to keep.

lines.zh: 我只想要你身上的东西。
lines.en: It's what's on you I want.
Food is wasted on me.
Do not hold your hand that near.
I cannot chew any of that.
That's not worth mentioning.
Put it back in your bag.
You hit me and I didn't take a step.
My armor plate jabs you.

lines.zh: 再近，就要贴到我身上了。
lines.en: Any closer and you'll be against me.
I lean and you're pushed aside.

lines.zh: 你的靴子压住我的脚趾。
lines.en: Your boot pressed down on my toes.

lines.zh: 我的布条挂到你的护腕。
lines.en: A strip of my cloth snags your bracer.
My feet are rooted to the spot.

lines.zh: 你退了两步，我还在这里。
lines.en: Two steps back for you, and here I still am.

lines.zh: 尘土从我们之间升起来。
lines.en: Dust rises between us.

lines.zh: 我的骨头磕得响了一下。
lines.en: My bones knocked audibly.
There's someone else under the sand.

lines.zh: 我们互相看着，不说一句。
lines.en: We look at each other and say nothing.
It was buried shallower than I was.

lines.zh: 我们一起守着这片荒沙。
lines.en: We hold this empty sand together.
Its cloth is a little newer.
Back against back, we hold.
It went the other way.
Our shadows are both faint.

lines.zh: 风把我们中间的沙吹平。
lines.en: The wind smooths the sand between us.
After that we never crossed again.
I'll keep this bone.
I wind it into the cloth at my waist.

lines.zh: 我弯腰时，骨头咔了一声。
lines.en: My bones creak as I bend.
I can carry these fragments.
Iron things are what I like.
I push it into a gap in my chest.
It's been in the sand a long time.

lines.zh: 我把它放回原来的凹坑。
lines.en: I set it back in its hollow.

lines.zh: 我用一条布把它拖在身后。
lines.en: I drag it behind me by a strip of cloth.
I keep everything I find.
You turn around and meet me face on.
I'm pressing forward.
One reach and I have you.

lines.zh: 两只手一起抬到了胸前。
lines.en: Both hands come up before my chest.
Stone is pressed to your back.
I do not need to run at all.

lines.zh: 你把那东西攥得更紧了。
lines.en: You grip that thing harder now.

lines.zh: 你的气味顺着风送到我这里。
lines.en: Your scent rides the wind to me.
This one carries real weight.

lines.zh: 你从坡上下来时我就看见了。
lines.en: I saw you coming down the slope.

lines.zh: 还能喘几口气，你自己数。
lines.en: A few breaths left. Count them yourself.
The sand will drag at your feet.
I do not shout a single word.
You're very clear in front of me.

lines.zh: 这一掌我知道往哪儿落。
lines.en: I know where this blow lands.
I'm coming now.

lines.zh: 再往前，你也退不回去了。
lines.en: One step more and you can't go back either.
Just keep looking at me.

lines.zh: 我不转向，只朝一个方向走。
lines.en: I don't turn; I walk one line.
You circle; I circle too.
Slow, and I've never once rested.

lines.zh: 你的脚印在沙上很显眼。
lines.en: Your prints stand out in the sand.

lines.zh: 我没有肺，喘不上气也不碍事。
lines.en: I have no lungs; breathlessness doesn't matter.

lines.zh: 我们之间的距离在一点点消掉。
lines.en: The space between us is wearing away.
You've moved onto hard ground.
The sand keeps marking your path.
I stay pointed your way.
You change paths; the sand doesn't.
You're panting loudly.
A few more steps and I'm there.
You've little left in your hands.

lines.zh: 这一片光秃秃，藏不住人。
lines.en: Bare ground; nowhere to hide.
I listen to your footsteps.

lines.zh: 千年都等了，不差这一会儿。
lines.en: I've waited a thousand years; this is nothing.
Where you stopped to rest. Perfect.
That pause is enough for me to close in.
Either run, or stand there.

lines.zh: 你在前头，我的影子在你脚边。
lines.en: You're ahead; my shadow lies at your heels.
My palm drives into your chest.
You're shoved back two steps.

lines.zh: 我的手指抓进你的护甲缝。
lines.en: My fingers dig into a gap in your armor.

lines.zh: 这一掌带着整条臂的分量。
lines.en: This palm carries the weight of my whole arm.

lines.zh: 你挡了一只手，挡不住另一只。
lines.en: You blocked one hand, not the other.
I draw my arm back slowly.
There's a new claw mark on you.
My bandage has come loose.
I'm pressing you down.
Your knees have buckled.
I didn't use my full strength there.
You give a step; I take one.
My fists aren't very quick.
That pushed you further off.
I stop and settle where I stand.

lines.zh: 挨了这一下，你还能立着。
lines.en: You took that and you're still upright.
The second blow lands in the same spot.

lines.zh: 你的护甲在这里挡不住。
lines.en: Your armor will not help you here.
That one lands along your shoulder.
I push you away, slowly.
I rise up out of the sand.

lines.zh: 布条从我的脸上滑下来。
lines.en: The cloth slides off my face.
It's dry here. Just right for me.

lines.zh: 风把沙粒吹到我的伤口里。
lines.en: Wind blows sand into my wounds.

lines.zh: 我一节一节把脊背撑直。
lines.en: I straighten my spine joint by joint.
My plates settle into place one by one.

lines.zh: 我第一眼看的是太阳的方向。
lines.en: The first thing I check is the sun.

lines.zh: 沙子从我身上一直往下流。
lines.en: Sand keeps running off me.
Someone has passed this way.
I hear the wind far off.

lines.zh: 我开始往有阴影的地方走。
lines.en: I start moving toward the shade.

lines.zh: 我来了，这一次不会再睡。
lines.en: I'm here, and I won't sleep again.

lines.zh: 火烤着我的布，很快就焦了。
lines.en: Fire scorches my cloth, and it curls.

lines.zh: 我从石台上摔下，骨头一响。
lines.en: I fall off the stone ledge and my bones knock.

lines.zh: 水浸透我的布，我沉得很快。
lines.en: Water soaks my cloth and I sink fast.
The blast throws me onto the sand.

lines.zh: 箭头卡在我肩上的布缝里。
lines.en: The arrowhead sticks in a seam at my shoulder.

lines.zh: 光钻进我的骨头里，很闷。
lines.en: Light works into my bones, dull and deep.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，可我在变弱。
lines.en: I don't eat, yet I'm weakening.

lines.zh: 雷打在甲上，我整块都震。
lines.en: Lightning hits my armor and the shock runs through.
There's no sand here; I can't stand firm.
